definitions.full: H1332. Bithyah בִּתְיָה proper name, feminine (= יָהּ בַּת i.e. worshipper of Yah ? compare Phoenician proper name, feminine בתּבעל ) 1Chr 4:18 wife of Mered of Judah, called בַּתמַּֿרְעֹה .
